text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
――With the world still abuzz over Tanino 
Gimlet, I was about to discuss something 
with Tazuna-san.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You're... retiring as a Trainer...?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Did you make that decision... based on 
what happened with Tanino Gimlet?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explained that this decision came from 
my responsibility for failing to prevent 
her injury, as well as a sense that both 
she and I had given it our all—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I understand your thinking. But have 
you already discussed this with Tanino 
Gimlet...?"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ......I see. Then—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I know it might not be my place to say, 
but please, consult Tanino Gimlet at least 
once before making your final decision.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"If the two of you have truly made up your 
minds— then the Academy will respect your 
wishes."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(I thought we might share a drink together 
to celebrate a delightful bout of boredom, 
but...)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
(Confound these chains of destiny... So 
that's how you want to play it...?!)

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
――No, that's not right...! You... aren't 
supposed to be like this...!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I will take my leave――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after speaking with Tazuna. Having 
made up my mind and gathered my thoughts, 
I decided to talk to Tanino Gimlet about 
my future as her Trainer, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ――Kept you waiting, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ……'Sup!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to cut in, but could you give this 
one some advice before we talk? Seems 
she's hit a bit of a slump lately.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to spring this on you out of 
nowhere, Trainer. I just really, really 
want to become stronger!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I watched the Derby, I've 
thought... I have to run amazingly, just 
like you, Senpai! That's what I've been 
aiming for!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
So she came to me for advice about various 
things. ...I figured that you'd be much 
better suited to teach her than me, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
After all, you are the formidable Trainer— 
who managed to see me through the Mile 
Championship rotation.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...Can I leave it to you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Hearing that from Tanino Gimlet, there 
was no way I could refuse.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ââHaa, haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: —Uwooooooooh!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh. What a splendid spurt. You 
maintained your top speed remarkably well.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes...! It felt super easy to run even 
for me...! So that was where I should've 
accelerated...!"
choice_data_list:
You've gotten better at shifting your 
weight through the corners, too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Until yesterday, I was seriously stressing 
over how to make sharp, snappy moves like 
you, Senpai, but that last run felt 
amazing!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to your guidance, Trainer! 
Thank you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
…………Yeah. I'd expect nothing less... from 
all of you――

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …………U-Um, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"It doesn't have to be right now. 
Someday...—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, would you please train me! I 
mean, like――――"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Into an Umamusume who can win the Japan 
Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a mercenary request... and I 
know it's incredibly rude...! I understand 
that!! But—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"The Trainer who coached Senpai told me 
about it—it was a race where Senpai looked 
insanely cool, and...—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna win too!!! I wanna become an 
incredible Umamusume, too!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a truly honoring request. But I 
cannot guide her future. Because I have 
already...... stopped in my tracks.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Because we still have things left to do.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Wait, but senpai is— Huh? The other day... 
wait, what? Hold on, please wait—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No way... It can't be...!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, could it be—wait, is it actually, 
really happening――?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. —From here on, we're aiming for our 
comeback.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
G-Gimlet-senpaaaaaaaai!!! I did 
iiiiiiit!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka. I apologize, but after this, I need 
to speak with my Trainer about what lies 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Keep what you heard today to yourself for 
a while. ...You can manage that, right?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, ma'am!! I won't tell a soul, 'ssu!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: —Good girl.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with Vodka, who 
couldn't conceal her joy, Tanino Gimlet 
and I were left alone—
choice_data_list: What on earth do you think you're doing?
What on earth do you think you're doing?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I'll admit that I acted unfairly. I 
needlessly misled you."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: About that... I'm sorry.
choice_data_list: ...You'll tell me about it, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...I was able to complete the MC rotation 
exactly the way I wanted to. I have no 
regrets whatsoever about that.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, completing the Mile Championship 
rotation and exhausting all of her 
potential... brought not a shred of fear 
or regret.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even if there were an alternate timeline 
where I managed to complete the MC 
rotation on my own... I wouldn't have 
hesitated to fade into the background.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: But――――I had you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Burning through my potential poses no 
issue at all. In fact, it feels like 
destiny.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Still, you're different...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing how you coached Vodka today made 
me certain once more. You are an 
indispensable presence for the glorious 
chaos to come.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Your potential and brilliance as a Trainer 
are by no means things that should be 
extinguished now...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Even more so, having your potential locked 
away because of my actions— goes against 
my entire aesthetic!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: I would never wish for an end like that!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A warmth welled up from deep within, but 
it was immediately capped by a cold 
emotion, tucked away into the depths of my 
heart...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You feel responsible, you say? Splendid. 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Take responsibility and walk this harsh 
path with me once more, for the 
culmination of my ideals.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
—Will I be able to achieve a greater feat 
than the Mile Championship rotation?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
One more time, Trainer. Write the script 
again with me—and with *me*.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"And through that great achievement... 
Grant further eternity to this fleeting, 
dazzling brilliance! Grant continuity to 
your potential!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The sound of something breaking echoed 
within me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I have shown you the path. The one who 
makes the final choice... is you."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Did you————see it through to the end?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I grasp Tanino Gimlet's hand firmly. Then, 
without any embellishment, I put what 
wells up inside me into words.
choice_data_list: I!! Want to get even more drunk on you!!!

I... I want to be even more intoxicated by 
you!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So that her words won't dissolve into the 
evening sky. So that Tanino Gimlet won't 
vanish. I fasten the chain to her.
choice_data_list:
So take on the challenge with me one more 
time!!

So take on the challenge with me one more 
time!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
The curtain has risen once more. ————Our 
second act begins now.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Now then. Regarding a 'greater feat 
than the MC rotation'— do you have any 
ideas?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...There was only one grueling rotation 
in my mind that could serve as an 
extension of the Mile Championship 
rotation."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, I felt a certain hesitation about 
proposing that idea myself. And that was 
because――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying that failing to prevent my 
injury strips you of the right to make a 
proposal?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. What an expressive face. Thanks to 
that, I'm now certain you're thinking the 
exact same thing as me...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, let's check your answers. Let me hear 
it. The ruinous vision of the future that 
you hold!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...With that push of encouragement, I make 
up my mind and speak my thoughts aloud.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, the "MC Rotation" is meant 
to prove one's innate, god-given talent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At its core lies the philosophy of proving 
the "speed" to conquer the mile and the 
"strength" to conquer 2,400m during the 
Classic year, before the body is fully 
mature.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If you aim for achievements beyond that— 
you need to show the results of rigorous 
training, in addition to your natural 
talent...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In other words, in your Senior year with a 
fully developed body, you'll deliver 
results across back-to-back mile and 
medium-distance races. The stage for that 
is—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
From the race that crowns the pinnacle of 
milers, to the festival that determines 
the strongest of the medium-distance era. 
A grueling series of back-to-back races in 
June. In other words—
choice_data_list:
The Yasuda Kinen and the Takarazuka Kinen, 
back-to-back...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Hahahaha...—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Bwaaaaa-hahahahaaa!!!!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
How utterly delightful! To lead all those 
observers by the nose, only to choose an 
even harsher path!
choice_data_list: —This time, I will definitely protect you.

—This time, I will protect you no matter 
what.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Those are good eyes. Madness is 
swirling within them once more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the major goal of targeting the 
Senior Year's Yasuda Kinen and Takarazuka 
Kinen decided, the next step was to go 
over the plans for her upcoming comeback—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...While rest is the fundamental 
priority, I must do rehab-oriented 
training to prevent my body from going 
dull."
choice_data_list: Let's be especially careful this June.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. We shouldn't enter any races at all, 
and instead make this a period to build up 
power in my legs.
choice_data_list:
During summer camp, we'll monitor your 
recovery step by step.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No objections here. Heh heh— Walking on 
thin ice in the heat of summer, is it?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And so, where shall we set the stage for 
my rebirth?
choice_data_list:
Let's make the Kobe Shimbun Hai the stage 
for your full comeback.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Kobe Shimbun Hai" is a GII race held 
in September. Normally, Umamusume aiming 
for the "Kikuka Sho" run it as an interim 
milestone, but――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
2400m on turf... I see. By getting results 
at the same distance as the Japan Derby, I 
will prove that I'm still as formidable as 
ever...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the timing is good. If there's no 
sign of recovery by then, the path would 
be cut off either way—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It is decided, then. Now... let us journey 
together into this summer of rebirth.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, setting the Kobe Shimbun Hai as 
the goal for her complete comeback, she 
began taking steps forward with Tanino 
Gimlet once again...!
